description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D2y_periodic. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=4 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D(D(u,y),y) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior 3-point centered y second-difference aggregate over rows [2,3] all i; periodic-wrap centered y-faces at j=1 and j=4 over the (4 x 1) strips), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names (the free name dy remains). The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
